decision_rule: If every repaired family reaches 20 passing outputs, compose passing v4 and v5 search records with the immutable v2-v3 artifact and train exactly the already-locked six-block balanced candidate. claim_boundary: V5 is the only repair authorized by the measured v4 failures. It provides no candidate or promotion credit.
